proposal.human_instructions: In demo/compose.yaml, correct the shop-proxy Caddy configuration so its upstream points to shop-web on port 8000 instead of 172.23.0.4:8001. Apply the change with `docker compose -f demo/compose.yaml up -d shop-proxy`.
